data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's radiatively shielded cavity analogy shares mechanism with SRC_004's thermos analogy (both depend on obstructing a view to a cold sink), but SRC_001's version is compatible with the counterconditions in SRC_005 because it acknowledges wind and anthropogenic heat as disanalogies, whereas SRC_004's closed-vacuum model is contradicted by SRC_005's explicit countercondition that high wind speeds mechanically flush canyons. This contradiction between SRC_004 and SRC_005 is refuted if 'high wind' is defined so strictly that it never co-occurs with the clear, calm conditions under which the thermos analogy is intended to apply, rendering the contradiction merely apparent.
